description: Phase 4A: Core interactivity - planet management, ships, fleets, combat

tasks.name: Planet management screen
tasks.description: Full planet screen with production sliders (SHIP/DEF/IND/ECO/TECH). Reference design/ui-ux/wireframes/planet-management.md and design/economy/slider-mathematics.md. Sliders must sum to 100%, show current allocation, and dispatch actions to update state.
acceptance: Accessible from galaxy map planet click

tasks.name: Ship components JSON data
tasks.description: Create comprehensive ship components JSON from design docs. Include weapons (design/technology/weapons.md), armor/shields (force-fields.md), engines (propulsion.md), computers, and specials. Each component needs: id, name, techLevel, size, cost, and type-specific stats.
acceptance: All weapon types from weapons.md included
All armor types with HP multipliers
All engine types with warp/combat speed

tasks.name: Ship designer game logic
tasks.description: Implement ship design validation and cost calculation in src/game/. Reference design/ships/ship-design.md. Validate hull space, calculate costs, check tech requirements.

tasks.name: Ship designer UI screen
tasks.description: Full ship designer screen per design/ui-ux/wireframes/ship-design.md. Hull selection, component slots, stats preview, save design.
acceptance: Component slots for weapons, armor, shields, engine, specials
Shows remaining space and total cost
Save design button creates ShipDesign in state

tasks.name: Ship construction system
tasks.description: Add ship construction to production system. When SHIP slider > 0, accumulate BC toward current ship design. When complete, spawn ship at planet. Reference design/economy/ship-costs.md.
acceptance: SHIP slider allocates production to shipyard
Ship added to planet's local fleet

tasks.name: Fleet state and actions
tasks.description: Expand fleet state management. Fleets contain ships, have location, destination, ETA. Actions for move, merge, split, scrap.
acceptance: Fleet has ships[], location, destination, eta
moveFleet() sets destination and calculates ETA
Turn processing moves fleets toward destination

tasks.name: Fleet management UI
tasks.description: Fleet screen showing all fleets, their composition, destinations. Allow selecting fleet and setting destination on galaxy map.
acceptance: Lists all player fleets with location
Shows destination and ETA if moving
Can select fleet on galaxy map

tasks.name: Colony ship and colonization
tasks.description: Colony ship special: when fleet with colony ship reaches uncolonized habitable planet, option to colonize. Colony ship consumed, planet becomes colony.
acceptance: Colony Ship is special ship type
Arriving at uncolonized planet triggers colonize option
New colony has starting population and factories

tasks.name: Full technology tree JSON
tasks.description: Complete all 6 tech fields from design docs: weapons.md, propulsion.md, construction.md, computers.md, force-fields.md, planetology.md. Each tech needs: id, name, field, tier, cost, unlocks[], description.

tasks.name: Research screen UI
tasks.description: Research screen per design/ui-ux/wireframes/research-tree.md. Shows 6 fields, current research per field, RP allocation sliders, tech choices.
acceptance: Current tech and progress per field
When tech completes, show choices (2-3 techs)

tasks.name: Tactical combat engine
tasks.description: Combat resolution engine per design/ships/combat-algorithm.md. Hex grid, initiative, movement, firing, damage resolution. Start with auto-resolve; manual control later.
acceptance: Combat ends when one side eliminated or retreats

tasks.name: Tactical combat UI
tasks.description: Combat screen with hex grid, ship positions, firing. Auto-resolve button + manual controls.
acceptance: Auto-resolve button runs combat to completion
Return to galaxy map after combat

tasks.name: Basic AI opponent
tasks.description: Basic AI that manages production, builds ships, expands to nearby planets. Reference design/species/ai-archetypes.md for personality types.
acceptance: AI builds colony ships early game
AI sends fleets to attack if at war

tasks.name: Turn processing integration
tasks.description: Wire all systems into turn processing. Fleet movement, combat triggers, AI turns, colonization checks.
acceptance: Arriving fleets trigger combat or colonize
